fact: Finance Minister Mohamed Maait says the e-payment service for government employees' payrolls grew 24% to EGP 299.4 billion in July 2023 to May 2024.
Al-Ahram reports NOSI pays about LE22 billion a month to 10.7 million pensioners, with 5.5 million already using new Meeza cards and pensions transferable to bank accounts or mobile e-wallets.

Egypt's finance minister said electronic payment of state employees' salaries reached EGP 299.4 billion in July 2023 to May 2024, up 24% on the year before, through the Ministry of Finance's government e-payment and collection centre.
